data.summary: Recovered context and decided on next action for Think Free mission. Key evidence: view-count principle works on platforms with exposable metadata (PyPI, NPM, Discourse, Stack Exchange), fails on platforms without (GitHub issues, web search/Bing). E098 shows discrimination test passes with SE API metadata (G2 TPR=0.80), while E083/E085 show it fails with Bing web search + keyword classifier (G2 0.70 vs 0.85 required). D095 prohibits 'classify_served over Bing in eighth domain'. The pyprovides resolver (E086-import-error-demand) has measured demand (19.35% module-only rate >> 1% kill gate) but usage impact unmeasured. Per STATE-next-actions.md item 55, the single most useful next action is to measure actual usage of pyprovides fix-import in developer workflows, answering whether measured demand translates to practical utility. This uses existing built code, fits the 'reversible exploratory prototype' authorization, and advances a concrete problem (developer productivity on import errors) rather than continuing the 20+ experiment fault-code domain line with no candidate validation.
